concerns.text: Phases 6 (Narrative Dynamics) and 7 (Control Simulation) introduce unapproved scope (tempo, affect, 'told vs. experienced' simulation) absent from spec.md and plan.md. This violates Constitution Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) and silently relaxes the project's defined boundaries. The 'Notes' section contradicts itself by claiming these were 'REMOVED' while the task list explicitly implements them.

Task T008-SEQ implements a 'Plan override of Spec FR-001' (sequential execution vs. 8-core parallelization). While the plan authorizes this, the task list fails to include a corresponding task to formally update spec.md to reflect this critical constraint change, leaving the spec and tasks in a state of permanent contradiction regarding resource usage.

Tasks T017 (error handling) and T018 (data hygiene/checksums) are marked as incomplete ('[ ]') despite being mandatory acceptance criteria for spec.md FR-001 (checksum verification) and the Edge Cases (motion artifact logging). The task list fails to preserve the requirement that these must be implemented before US1 verification.

Tasks T012 (segmentation verification) and T023 (FDR correction) are flagged with '[UNRESOLVED-CLAIM]' status. This indicates the tasks do not currently contain a verifiable implementation path for spec.md Success Criteria SC-001 and SC-002, effectively dropping the acceptance criteria for statistical significance and segmentation accuracy.

Tasks T029 (BERT extraction) and T030 (Decoder) risk violating the plan's strict methodology (Neural Input -> Label Output) by not explicitly gating the decoder to exclude text features. The task descriptions lack the explicit 'gate' or constraint verification required to prevent the circularity violation warned against in plan.md.
